b092: Side effects / stop signs: The big one to watch out for is agitation + sweating + diarrhea + tremor/clonus + fever, confusion, fast heart rate, or unstable blood pressure. Stop immediately if you get that, since it can be a sign of serotonin toxicity, which can become dangerous. Other stop signs include nausea, stomach discomfort, loose stools, headache, vivid or intense dreams, insomnia, sweating, tremor, anxiety, irritability, emotional agitation, or a too-bright / hypomanic feeling.
b093: Hard interaction rule: Don't mix 5-HTP casually with other serotonin-raising drugs or supplements, as serotonin syndrome is most often a multi-drug / stack problem. There's case literature and clinical reviews warning about that risk when 5-HTP is combined with antidepressants or MAOIs (see this dietary supplement interaction case report). MedlinePlus also has a general overview of serotonin syndrome. If you're doing psychedelics, avoid 5-HTP on your psychedelic days, and be especially strict around ayahuasca / harmala MAOI chemistry and iboga / ibogaine.
